options.name: certificate_label
options.description: The label of certificate that will be connected to the keyring

options.name: certificate_owner
options.description: The owner of certificate that will be connected to the keyring

options.name: keyring_owner
options.description: The owner of the keyring, in case it is omitted it will ussume is the same as ansible_user

options.name: list_only
options.description: When true module will only execute a list to the keyring

options.name: state
options.description: This field is required in case list_only is true If `present` checks if keyring exists if not create If `absent` checks if keyring exists if so deletes If `connect` it will connect the keyring with certificate data passed through `certificate_owner` and `certificate_label` If `remove` will remove the connection  from keyring with certificate data passed through `certificate_owner` and `certificate_label`
